integrity: Full symbolic proof and self-contained integer verifier included; finite verification corroborates but does not certify all-order claims.
scientific_limitations: Only induced connected vertex intervals of paths, restricted by the parity of the number of vertices. Multivariate subtree enumerators predate this Fourier-rank characterization. No general-tree theorem or endpoint projection constant is claimed; possible unindexed equivalence remains a priority risk.
title: Parity-resolved Fourier recovery for connected induced subpaths
